title: Effects of Water and Chemical Solutions Ageing on the Physical, Mechanical, Thermal and Flammability Properties of Natural Fibre-Reinforced Thermoplastic Composites
authors: Baljinder K. Kandola; S. Ilker Mistik; Wiwat Pornwannachai; A. Richard Horrocks
TGA_instrument: SDT 2960 Simultaneous DTA-TGA instrument, TA Instruments, Elstree, Hertfordshire, UK
TGA_specimen_preparation: Unaged finished textile laminate, dried in an oven at 50 °C for 24 h before DTA-TGA. The source uses 10–15 mg samples from room temperature to 700 °C in flowing air at 100 mL/min and 10 °C/min. Cutting, grinding, pan and through-thickness aliquot selection are unreported.
LOI_method: Fire Testing Technology Limiting Oxygen Index Tester; ISO 4589; measured oxygen index
LOI_statistic: Source reports one tabulated LOI per state without dispersion
LOI_specimen_preparation: Unaged control laminate, dimensions 12.5 mm × 100 mm × the Table 1 thickness. Table 3 compares unaged controls with aged and oven-dried specimens. A separate conditioning procedure for the unaged LOI control is not stated. The 50 °C for 24 h treatment is explicit for TG aliquots and aged specimens; it is not independently assigned as an unreported control LOI conditioning step.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Own measured Table 3 LOI and own Table 4 experimental TGA data, verified in original PDF pixels and PMC HTML. Figure 8 and Figure 10 inspected for conflicts without extracting coordinates.
TG_locator: Table 4 and its definitions, p 17; experimental versus calculated distinction pp 16–18; own thermal method section 4.6 p 22
LOI_locator: Table 3 unaged rows, p 11; LOI discussion section 2.3.1 p 15; own measured-LOI method section 4.5 p 22
conditions_locator: Table 1 and Figure 1 p 3; materials section 4.1 pp 20–21; laminate preparation section 4.2 p 21; own methods sections 4.5–4.6 p 22
source_location: Published original 24-page article, Tables 1/3/4 and sections 2.3–2.4 and 4.1–4.6; institutional PDF and PMC original HTML. Related 2018 accepted manuscript separately reviewed for observation reuse.
washing_state: Unaged manufactured control; no durability wash or aqueous ageing assigned
treatment_chemistry: Thermoplastic consolidation of needle-punched woven natural fabric and nonwoven polymer web; no flame-retardant chemical finish
treatment_method: Loomstate plain woven reinforcing fabric was combined with carded PP or PLA staple-fibre nonwoven webs using an Automatex carding machine followed by an Automatex needle-punching machine. Section 4.2 refers to a 40:60 w/w web/fabric feed, while the cited earlier preparation explicitly calls this woven fabric/thermoplastic fibre 40:60. This ordering ambiguity is retained; Table 1 separately reports the actual fibre/polymer composition for each laminate. Eight preform layers between aluminium plates were heated at 190 °C for 2.5 min at 20 kg/cm², then the plate-composite assembly was transferred to another water-cooled press for 2 min at 10 kg/cm². Jute and sisal fabrics were from NITTRAD, Bangladesh; wool supplier is unreported. PP staple fibres were 50 mm, 3.3 dtex; PLA fibres were 40 mm, 2.2 dtex. The source refers detailed needle settings to the 2018 preparation paper; these settings are not transferred into the own-method fields.
source_T10_T50_definition_raw: Table 4 footnote: T10 = Temp. at 10% mass; T50 = Temp. at 50% mass. Section 2.4 p 17 explicitly defines these as temperatures at 10% and 50% mass loss. The source also calls them respective onset of decomposition and maximum mass loss conditions; no separate Tonset or Tmax is inferred from that prose.
source_Tmax_definition: Table 4 explicitly labels the TGA-column temperatures DTG Peak Maxima. DTA decomposition temperatures appear in separate columns and are not substituted.
source_residue_definition: Table 4 TGA Analysis, Char at 500 °C (%), from experimental composite TG; no glass/fibre subtraction or calculated weighted-average curve used.
limitations: Five unaged textile-laminate compositions are represented. All paired numerical values appear in the same original study. Four jute/sisal LOIs and composition rows also match the earlier 2018 preparation paper, which contains no TGA assay; these are repeated LOI observations, not independent LOI replicates. The later study provides the own experimental TG values. The earlier source therefore requires sample-scoped reuse exclusion for those four control names. Its LOI width and repetition details are not substituted for the later study methods. Table 4 reports experimental composite TG separately from the calculated component-weighted curves in Figure 9; only the former is used. The Table 4 abbreviated T10/T50 footnote says mass, while section 2.4 explicitly defines mass loss. DTA peaks remain separate from DTG peak maxima. The nominal web/fabric feed order in section 4.2 is ambiguous relative to the cited earlier preparation wording; row-specific actual fibre/polymer fractions follow Table 1 without inverting or reconstructing them. TG aliquot cutting, pan, through-thickness sampling and replication are unreported. The two replicates stated for flexural and horizontal-burn tests are not assigned to TG or LOI. Ageing values in Figure 10 have no exact numerical point annotations and are not digitized or paired to the separate aged LOIs. Neat PP/PLA thermal data and cited background fibre LOIs are not admitted as textile pairs. The original PDF contains duplicate invisible extracted text around some figures; visible original table cells and the original PMC HTML agree.
material_form: plain woven jute fabric/PP laminate from woven-nonwoven textile preform
material_form_TGA: plain woven jute fabric/PP laminate from woven-nonwoven textile preform
material_form_LOI: plain woven jute fabric/PP laminate from woven-nonwoven textile preform
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Finished Jute/PP composite, own experimental Table 4, eight-layer woven-nonwoven preform hot-pressed laminate
composition: 42 wt% jute fabric and 58 wt% PP matrix; 31 vol% reinforcing fibre (Table 1)
source_nominal_feed_order_raw: Section 4.2: each nonwoven web and the reinforcing fabric in 40:60 (w/w) ratio; earlier 2018 section 2.2: woven fabric/thermoplastic fibre ratio 40:60 (w/w)
pairing_evidence: The same original Table 1 prepared composition is named Jute/PP in the unaged row of measured-LOI Table 3 and experimental-TGA Table 4. Section 4.2 describes consolidation into an eight-layer textile laminate; section 4.6 assays composite aliquots. No precursor or separate fibre TG replaces the finished laminate values.
cross_paper_reuse_note: The earlier 2018 accepted original Table 1 and Table 4 repeat Jute/PP composition and LOI 18.7; it has no TGA assay. Retain a future reuse exclusion for this earlier exact native sample label; the 2021 paper supplies matched own experimental TG.
